lengths_3_3: A key's place is read off how the scripts use it, per literal occurrence, from the code on the same line before the literal (non-test scripts). Tooltip: the first argument of tipAttr/tipText, the second of setTip, inside a data-tooltip="${...}" or title="${...}" attribute, after `tooltip:`, assigned to dataset.tooltip(Text) or .title, or an iconButton's label (its aria-label and data-tooltip). Tab: `{ key: "...", label: L("...") }` with kitTabs(, kitTabBar(, tabs: or sections in the 1200 characters before; ROOM_SETUP_TABS rows. Button: inside <button ...>...</button> text, roleButton's label, or `label:` of an object with `action:` on its line, or under primary/secondary/destructive/gmRoute/yes/ok/close/no or a DialogV2 `buttons: [`. Window title: `title:` with drpgWindow(, drpgConfirm(, drpgPrompt(, DialogV2.wait/confirm/prompt/input, new DialogV2(, frame( or `window: {` in the 900 characters before. HUD: any literal in hud.mjs or hud-elapsed.mjs; status strip: any literal in player-status.mjs; both less a line that posts a notification or a card.

A key no usage rule places takes docs/text-budgets.json's name rule, the first that names it in its order (tooltip, button, tab, window title), the diagnostics groups left out; 'by' says which: usage, name, or usage+name. A plural family's base names all its forms.
